\section{Pixel-path verdict, round 2: a spline joint fit, lean-error scoring, and two more
extractors}
\label{sec:pixel-path-round2}

\paragraph{Decision.}
\textbf{Fail.} With estimated attitude and any stored pixel path the pre-registered
spline-and-flatness statistic flags at most 2/8 real clips but detects only 1/8 tilt removals
and 2--3/8 mirrored rolls (AUC 0.53--0.70), against a 90\,\% bar on both named paths. On the
truth path the same statistic reaches 8/8 and 6/8 at AUC 1.00/0.97, so the analytic-derivative
form is sound but more path-sensitive than round~1's integrated statistic (pixel-path AUC
0.95/0.89).

\paragraph{Question and pre-registration.}
Round~1 left two constraints: the path, and a conformal threshold calibrated on six clips in
four sequences. Round~2's part~1 tests the nearest published idea (Kinetodynamic priors): fit a
smooth B-spline to the recovered path, take its acceleration analytically, and fit the
flatness prediction
$a = g\,\mathrm{Rz}(\psi+\mathrm{yaw})\,\ell - k_d v$ jointly in the positive path scale $s$
and a free initial velocity $v_0$. The gate, population, edits, controls and pairing are
round~1's, unchanged: $s$, $\psi$ and $v_0$ are fitted on the real condition and held fixed
for its edits, LOSO conformal threshold at 0.95 on real clips, and pass on both DPVO and ViPE
if the false-reject rate is at most 15\,\% and removal and mirror detection each at least
90\,\%. The 0.90 and 0.99 levels are reported to separate threshold from statistic.

\paragraph{Population.}
Eight real clips in four indoor-forward sequences (\texttt{indoor\_forward\_3}, \_5, \_9,
\_10; clips \#00 and \#01) with a full 60-frame path, the frozen confidence gate and E's
testability rules; the exploratory set is every other real clip with a path. The spline knots
come from the E05 rule ($h = 0.5/f_{95}$, $K = \max(4,\mathrm{round}(T/h))$, median 4.5
intervals), not from the outcome.

\paragraph{Why it fails, and why it is not the threshold.}
Two mechanisms are measured. First, the joint fit is degenerate: a free $v_0$ can cancel a
constant part of the forcing in $a_m = f - k_d(H v_0 + F)$, so on real clips whose acceleration
shape disagrees with the lean the least squares drives $s\to 0$ --- the median fitted scale is
0.33--0.54 of the Sim(3) truth scale and four to five of the eight primary clips sit below half
of it --- and the real statistic reaches 2.5--6.1, dragging the LOSO threshold to 4.5--5.9.
Second, comparing accelerations is stricter than comparing positions: the statistic is a ratio
of acceleration energies, so a path error that round~1's position-integrated statistic absorbed
is a large fraction here (truth-path floor 0.17--0.54, pixel-path real values 0.26--6.09).
Neither is a threshold artefact: at the 0.90, 0.95 and 0.99 levels the detection stays at
1--2/8 for every path. A no-free-velocity variant, declared after the result and labelled
exploratory throughout, repairs some clips but not others and does not improve the AUCs.
Knot density ($K\pm1$), $k_d=0$ and a per-condition $\psi$ refit leave the conclusion unchanged.

\paragraph{What the verifier needs from a path (part 2).}
The bake-off scores a path by its median acceleration direction. Part~2 measures instead the
thrust-axis error the path implies, in the E05 windows, with oracle attitude and the Sim(3)
evaluation transform. The ordering changes: DPVO 3.69$^\circ$ (bake-off 4.18$^\circ$), Pi3X
4.19$^\circ$ (12.92$^\circ$), ViPE 6.19$^\circ$ (3.97$^\circ$), MASt3R 10.49$^\circ$
(39.05$^\circ$), MapAnything 12.43$^\circ$ (40.61$^\circ$). The two metrics correlate at
0.65 (sequence-clustered 0.38--0.83 over 50 path--sequence pairs), and the windowed lean error
does not predict per-clip verdict quality well (Spearman 0.22--0.46 against the part-1
statistic). ViPE is the clearest disagreement: best median direction, worse windowed thrust
axis than DPVO on six of ten sequences.

\paragraph{Two more extractors (part 3).}
MapAnything (Apache-2.0 weights, ungated) is the best metric-scale result in the project ---
Sim(3) scale 0.83--1.47, median 1.20 --- and fails the bake-off on all ten sequences because its
acceleration direction is 22--83$^\circ$ and its magnitude ratio 1.4--15; metric space does not
imply motion fidelity. Pi3X with the Kalibr matrix passes 6/10 (all six indoor-forward
sequences, 6.5--14.0$^\circ$, 0.11--0.32 m ATE) and is second by windowed lean error; fed into
part~1 it gives removal 0/8 and mirror 2/8, so the gate fails on the best new extractor too.
VGGT's released API takes no intrinsics and FFVO has no code release; both are recorded rather
than worked around. The MapAnything intrinsics input documented in its README raises an
\texttt{IndexError} in the released code, so that run is image-only.

\paragraph{The simulated set (part 4) is waiting.}
Track~I's I02 commit (\texttt{2d815cc}) freezes a 300-clip, 149{,}450-frame labelled set with
dev/held-out splits by scene family, and eight clips are rendered on the
\texttt{awmv-i-data} volume; there is no I02 report yet. The registered leave-scene-out run
needs the full render and is not performed on eight clips.

\paragraph{Scope.}
Eight clips in four sequences, 1/8 granularity, descriptive clustered intervals. The real
path is reused for every edit (one-sequence edit-invariance check: 0.81$^\circ$ median step
direction on DPVO). The scale diagnostic uses the Sim(3) truth scale and is evaluation-only.
Round~2 does not change round~1's conclusion, it sharpens it: the path is the binding error,
and the statistic that survives it must not let the ruler collapse.
